### Meaning
| infl.  | class     | meaning                         |
| ------ | --------- | ------------------------------- |
| ~      | *n.*      | unit                            |
| pe ~   | *quant.*  | one                             |
| pe ni~ | *ordinal* | first                           |
| ~an    | *adj.*    | individual, single, alone, only |
| ~un    | *adv.*    | only                            |
| ni~un  | *adv.*    | firstly                         |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
From the native "1-4-7" numerical system.
#### Sound
- Japanese "hi"
- Numbers always end in a nasal coda ("n")
